svg.title: How baton works
svg.desc: Agents (orchestrator, backend, frontend, qa) run baton post, reply, handoff and unread. These append to .baton/events/<sprint>.jsonl under a lock; it is the source of truth. baton renders .baton/BOARD.md, .baton/STATUS.md, .baton/archive/BOARD-<sprint>.md and .baton/CONTRACTS-INDEX.md from it. Per-agent cursors mean each agent reads each event once.
